label: Create an appointment
hint: Draw a slot, enter a title, and save.
paragraphs: Appointments can be created with an external control or by drawing time directly on the timeline.
The calendar shows the appointment while it is being edited. It can keep only the selected doctor in view, making it easier to find that person’s next available time.
The application can also show when an appointment is being saved and when it has settled, so the server can give feedback to the user.
